narrator.description: A warm, friendly American man in his forties narrating a classic animated family film. Cozy storybook tone, gentle humor, crisp and clear, slightly playful.

serpent.description: A cartoon snake villain who talks like a slick used-car salesman. Middle-aged American man, smooth and oily, sly and smug, very theatrical, with a subtle hiss stretching his S sounds.

eve.description: A sassy, quick-witted cartoon heroine. Young American woman, bright and expressive, constantly exasperated, sharp comedic timing like a sitcom lead.

adam.description: A lovable, dim cartoon husband. Young American man, goofy, earnest and cheerful, a little dopey, very expressive like an animated sitcom dad.

god.description: A kind elderly grandfather in an animated film. Deep, soft and warm American voice, patient, gently amused and a little tired.

noah.description: A grumpy old cartoon boat captain. Gravelly, gruff American man in his seventies, bossy and deadpan, sounds like he has explained this too many times.
